description: Read-only search for activities by location/query/date. Each result includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, `group_size`, and a standardized `item_card`.

includes_children.description: Alias for has_children, kept for older clients. Prefer has_children.
includes_children.title: Includes Children

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-25).
limit.title: Limit

location.description: Where to search: a place name or address (e.g. "Key West, FL"), a "lat,lng" string, or an object with `lat` and `lng`. If omitted, a place name in `query` is used as the location when one is found.
location.title: Location

party_size.description: Number of guests in the group.
party_size.title: Party Size

query.description: Free-text keywords, e.g. "sunset sail" or "food tour".
query.title: Query

radius_miles.description: Search radius around the location, in miles (max 1000).
radius_miles.title: Radius Miles

name: search_activities
